text_block_list.text:
I was able to deliver results in the 
Victoria Mile!

Even while complaining, Sweep-san was 
worried about me. Seeing her smiling makes 
me happy as well!

And the reason she was able to come this 
far after so much soul-searching was all 
thanks to you, Trainer...

You're the best partner ever! Together, 
let's become "Purify"'s legendary Trainer 
and legendary Princess!

Next up is the Takarazuka Kinen! I'm going 
to run completely wild! Roar, 
Princess☆Busteeer!!
